name: Tuya blinds
description: Tuya blinds, curtains and shutters driven over your network with their local key, no cloud.
author: LocalAssistant

device.title: Add a Tuya blind
device.description: Give the blind a fixed IP in your router so it stays reachable. The device ID and local key come from the Tuya developer site or tinytuya.

fields.name: host
fields.label: IP address
fields.message: Type the blind's IP address on your network.

fields.name: deviceId
fields.label: Device ID
fields.message: Paste the device ID from Tuya.

fields.name: localKey
fields.label: Local key
fields.message: Paste the 16-character local key from Tuya.

fields.name: controlDp
fields.label: Commands data point
fields.description: Most blinds use 1, 2 and 3. Others list theirs in the Tuya device details.
